## Traps and pitfalls

1. **LFL vs Actual.** Every trading statement defaults to LFL ("year-on-year organic growth of continuing operations at constant currency"). Drivers asking for *actual* growth must use the **Actual** column (Q3 26 −7%, Q4 26 −4%), not the headline (−8%, −5%).
2. **Continuing-operations redefinition mid-year.** From Q4 26, Czech Republic, Denmark, Hungary, Luxembourg, Romania, Sweden are excluded from LFL following the 16 June 2026 disposal (`filings/2026-07-10__has-ln-20260710-q4-8k__1572805.md` line 79), but they still contributed c.£15m to *reported* FY26 net fees (line 132). Earlier exits: Chile, Colombia, Thailand, Mexico. Reported FY26 net fees ≠ LFL-consistent base.
3. **Adjusted vs GAAP.** Guidance and all "operating profit" references are **pre-exceptional**. FY26 exceptionals: c.£40m restructuring + c.£30m ROU impairment + disposal loss. H1 26 exceptional £8.8m (£7.3m restructuring + £1.5m transformation); FY25 £30.7m; FY24 £80.0m. Post-exceptional H1 26 EPS was 0.02p vs pre-exceptional 0.46p — do not mix.
4. **Fiscal calendar.** FY ends 30 June. H1 = Jul–Dec, H2 = Jan–Jun. Note the FY25 slide footnotes mislabel "H2 25 represents 01-Jul-24 to 30-Jun-25" (`slides/2025-08-21__has-ln-20250821-slide__143884.md` line 1084 and `slides/2026-02-27__has-ln-20260227-slide__643289.md` line 774) — this is a typo; H2 25 = 01-Jan-25 to 30-Jun-25.
5. **Two different consensus numbers exist** for FY26 op profit (£45.2m @15-Apr-2026; £43.5m @9-Jul-2026 with £37.0–46.0m range). Use the July one as "latest"; the range top is £46.0m.
6. **FX.** H1 26: FX increased net fees by £6.1m and op profit by £1.3m (line 302/356). Q3/Q4 26 actual growth is *better* than LFL because sterling weakened vs EUR/AUD, partly offset by country exits. Sensitivity: each 1c EUR move ≈ £4.0m net fees / £0.6m op profit p.a. (line 358).
7. **Quarterly net fees are never given in £** — only growth %. Any quarterly £ split is an assumption (see `q3_share_of_h2`).
8. **Restatement**: 31 Dec 2024 bank overdraft £25.5m re-presented out of cash (`filings/2026-02-27__has-ln-20260227-h1-8k__642921.md` line 697) — affects cash/overdraft lines only, not profit, EPS, net assets or net cash.
9. **Pension buy-in (FY25)** removed the IAS 19 net interest charge (H1 25 £0.8m → H1 26 £nil), lowering the FY26 finance charge run-rate.
10. **Management change**: Dirk Hahn (CEO) medical leave Nov 2025, departure announced 2026-02-27; Mark Dearnley interim then permanent CEO; CFO James Hilton presents H1 26 and Q4 26. Quotes attributed to the wrong CEO by date are a common error.
11. **Buybacks**: programme announced 2025-10-22 and increased 2026-06-08, completed 2026-06-29 — share count declines through H2 26, so H1 26 weighted average shares (1,595.7m) overstates the FY26 H2 count.
12. **Dividend rebase** (FY25 final 0.29p, H1 26 interim 0.15p) — not comparable to prior-year DPS.
